_comment: Backend mutation table — run it with:
The default table (tests/mutations.json) drives the vitest suite and cannot
reach touch_manager.py at all, so the description ladder and the loaded-node
index need their own. Reporter is exit-code: pytest's non-zero exit is the
signal, so a CAUGHT line here names no individual test.
The -k selection is deliberate: it scopes the run to the assertions these
mutations are meant to test, so CAUGHT means THOSE tests have teeth rather
than some unrelated suite-wide test happening to fail. It also keeps a run
at seconds instead of the ~13 minutes the full pytest suite would take.
As in the JS table, the last entry is a CONTROL that MUST be MISSED — a run
where everything is CAUGHT is indistinguishable from a harness that lies, so
this one exits 1 on a healthy run. Read the report, not the exit code.
command: description or node_index or describe_pack or clean_description

mutations.label: ladder reordered so the README outranks the authored pyproject description
length floor removed — a short label settles instead of descending
ComfyUI-Manager [a/Label](url) markup left raw in the description
HTML tags left in the description
length cap removed — one verbose pack can push the list off the screen
README structure filter dropped — headings/badges become the description
description cache never invalidates (an edited pyproject is not picked up)
